meta.title: Gita Grove — adventure curriculum
meta.localization: English-first; title_te and content_te filled via translation pass (skill/MCP) before print

adventures.title: The Fair Before the Drum
adventures.storyFeeling: Pausing when the world is loud; noticing who is left out
adventures.synopsis: Setup day for Spring Fair. Everyone runs toward noise and color. Kiki almost joins — then spots a tiny field mouse friend sitting alone on the wooden steps, too scared to come down. Kiki sits beside them instead of flying ahead. No sermon — just company until the mouse takes one step.
adventures.moral: Before you run toward the loud fun, look around — someone small might need you beside them.
adventures.guruMaLine: In the Bhagavad Gita, one of India's great puranas, a blind king asks his wise scribe: On the sacred field of Kurukshetra, where both armies stand ready — what are they doing? The question comes before the first drum of war.
adventures.page25Teaser: Spring Fair opens at sunrise tomorrow. The red cloth comes off the great drum — and Mimi the rabbit has been chosen to hold the opening ribbon at Courage Hill. Her paws are already shaking. Her tummy feels full of butterflies. Can you walk up a hill when your whole body says wait?
adventures.page25WonderQuestion: Can you walk up a hill when your whole body says wait?

adventures.title: Mimi's Butterflies
adventures.storyFeeling: Naming body fear before a big moment; walking anyway
adventures.synopsis: Mimi is chosen to hold the opening ribbon. Her paws shake; her tummy flips. She wants to hide behind Timo. Timo teaches a silly breath game (smell the flower, blow the candle). Mimi still feels scared — and walks to the hill anyway.
adventures.moral: You can tell the truth about a scared body — shaky paws and fluttery tummies are allowed. You can still take the next step.
adventures.childRepeatLine: I can name what my body feels.
adventures.guruMaLine: In the Bhagavad Gita, from India's puranas, the great warrior sees those he loves ready to fight. Filled with pity, he says: my limbs give way, my mouth goes dry, my whole body trembles. The holy teaching begins when the body speaks truth.
adventures.openingHook: Sunrise painted Courage Hill gold. Mimi stood at the bottom with the ribbon in her paws — and every butterfly in her tummy wanted to fly away.
adventures.page25Teaser: The ribbon fluttered. The crowd cheered. Now it was the friends' turn to carry the Grove team banner across Rainbow Bridge. Bobo grabbed the pole first. "I'll lead!" he shouted — and ran. What happens when the mud wins?
adventures.page25WonderQuestion: What happens when the mud wins?

adventures.title: The Banner in the Mud
adventures.storyFeeling: Letting disappointment show; friends stay without fixing
adventures.synopsis: Bobo grabs the team banner and sprints across the bridge. He slips; mud splashes; everyone laughs. Bobo laughs too — then walks away and cries where he thinks no one sees. Friends find him and sit in the mud. Nobody fixes it; they stay.
adventures.guruMaLine: In the Bhagavad Gita, from India's puranas, the warrior's bow slips from his hand. His skin burns; his mind reels. He says he sees no good ahead — and will not pretend otherwise.
adventures.openingHook: Rainbow Bridge was slippery after morning rain. Bobo didn't notice. He had the banner, the wind, and a very fast plan.
adventures.page25Teaser: The banner dried in the sun. Bobo washed his face. Mimi hummed. Kiki chattered. But Gulu the squirrel still had no job on the fair list — not one line with his name. He walked to the Tree of Wisdom and sat down without a word. What do you do when you don't know what to do?
adventures.page25WonderQuestion: What do you do when you don't know what to do?

adventures.title: Under the Quiet Tree
adventures.storyFeeling: Saying "I don't know" and choosing one small yes
adventures.synopsis: Gulu still has no role in the fair. He sits under the Tree, quiet. Guru Ma Owl doesn’t explain life — she listens. Gulu says, “I don’t know what to do.” Owl says, “That’s honest.” Gulu chooses one small yes: carry water for the flower table.
adventures.guruMaLine: In the Bhagavad Gita, from India's puranas, the warrior lays down his bow and sits, heart heavy with sorrow. He says, I will not fight — not from pride, but because he does not know what is right. That honest confusion opens the door to wisdom.
adventures.openingHook: The fair list was full of names — Mimi, Bobo, Kiki, Timo, Pip. Gulu read it twice. His name wasn't there.
adventures.page25Teaser: Kiki noticed someone small. Mimi breathed and walked. Bobo let friends see his tears. Gulu said, "I don't know" — and found one yes. Four friends. Four honest moments. One Spring Fair week. Coming in Book 2: Timo Won't Come Out.
adventures.page25WonderQuestion: The Grove keeps growing. Next time, feelings don't go away overnight...

adventures.title: Timo Won't Come Out
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo loses a simple ring-toss game in front of everyone. He retreats into his shell and misses the picnic. Friends leave snacks at the door. Next morning Timo peeks out — one inch.
adventures.synopsis: Timo loses a simple ring-toss game in front of everyone. He retreats into his shell and misses the picnic. Friends leave snacks at the door. Next morning Timo peeks out — one inch.

adventures.title: The Wrong Note
adventures.storyFeeling: Mimi practices a song for Grove Night. One wrong note; she stops and wants to quit forever. Owl hums the wrong note on purpose, grins, and keeps going. Mimi tries again — not perfect, finished.
adventures.synopsis: Mimi practices a song for Grove Night. One wrong note; she stops and wants to quit forever. Owl hums the wrong note on purpose, grins, and keeps going. Mimi tries again — not perfect, finished.

adventures.title: Leaves Everywhere
adventures.storyFeeling: Workers trim Gulu’s favorite climbing branch for safety. Gulu is furious, then heartbroken. Leaves fall like rain. He rakes them angry, then rakes them with Timo — same garden, new season.
adventures.synopsis: Workers trim Gulu’s favorite climbing branch for safety. Gulu is furious, then heartbroken. Leaves fall like rain. He rakes them angry, then rakes them with Timo — same garden, new season.

adventures.title: The Light That Stayed
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu’s caterpillar friend wraps in a cocoon. Days pass; Gulu waits, worried. Diya the firefly visits at dusk — “Some goodbyes are helloes in a coat.” Cocoon opens; moth flies; Gulu waves.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu’s caterpillar friend wraps in a cocoon. Days pass; Gulu waits, worried. Diya the firefly visits at dusk — “Some goodbyes are helloes in a coat.” Cocoon opens; moth flies; Gulu waves.

adventures.title: Hand-Me-Down Day
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo wears cousin’s old festival vest — too big, then just right. He feels small inside it, then proud. Same Timo, new cloth.
adventures.synopsis: Timo wears cousin’s old festival vest — too big, then just right. He feels small inside it, then proud. Same Timo, new cloth.

adventures.title: The Day the Finish Line Moved
adventures.storyFeeling: Sports day relay. Gulu is winning — Mimi trips ahead. He stops, helps her up, they finish last together. Coach claps loudest for that.
adventures.synopsis: Sports day relay. Gulu is winning — Mimi trips ahead. He stops, helps her up, they finish last together. Coach claps loudest for that.

adventures.title: Boats We Don't Chase
adventures.storyFeeling: Friends release paper boats with wishes. Current takes them. Bobo wants to run downstream and grab his back. They watch together until boats vanish — peaceful, not empty.
adventures.synopsis: Friends release paper boats with wishes. Current takes them. Bobo wants to run downstream and grab his back. They watch together until boats vanish — peaceful, not empty.

adventures.title: The Last Mango
adventures.storyFeeling: Feast prep — one mango left. Bobo almost eats it. Remembers the ant line waiting below. Splits it many ways; feast starts with sharing.
adventures.synopsis: Feast prep — one mango left. Bobo almost eats it. Remembers the ant line waiting below. Splits it many ways; feast starts with sharing.

adventures.title: Carry, Don't Boss
adventures.storyFeeling: Bridge boards loose. Bobo shouts orders; nothing moves. Gulu picks up a plank silently; others follow. Bridge steady by sunset.
adventures.synopsis: Bridge boards loose. Bobo shouts orders; nothing moves. Gulu picks up a plank silently; others follow. Bridge steady by sunset.

adventures.title: Mimi's Own Beat
adventures.storyFeeling: Drum circle — Mimi copies Bobo’s loud rhythm, fails, feels silly. Finds a soft tap-tap on seed pods that makes babies smile.
adventures.synopsis: Drum circle — Mimi copies Bobo’s loud rhythm, fails, feels silly. Finds a soft tap-tap on seed pods that makes babies smile.

adventures.title: The Middle Path
adventures.storyFeeling: Left path vs right path argument splits the team. Kiki walks the center rail — wobbly but funny — and describes what both sides actually see.
adventures.synopsis: Left path vs right path argument splits the team. Kiki walks the center rail — wobbly but funny — and describes what both sides actually see.

adventures.title: The Book That Came Back
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu finds a overdue storybook under roots. Returns it; Owl shows how stories help fix the garden map. Knowledge → happy sweeping.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu finds a overdue storybook under roots. Returns it; Owl shows how stories help fix the garden map. Knowledge → happy sweeping.

adventures.title: Timo's Happy Sweep
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo sweeps petals while others race. Passersby slip on paths he cleared. He hums; nobody notices until Mimi says, “Our shoes are clean because of you.”
adventures.synopsis: Timo sweeps petals while others race. Passersby slip on paths he cleared. He hums; nobody notices until Mimi says, “Our shoes are clean because of you.”

adventures.title: The Question Leaf
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu writes a question on a leaf — “Why do friends fight?” — and leaves it at Owl’s door. No answer lecture; Owl asks one question back. Gulu thinks all afternoon.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu writes a question on a leaf — “Why do friends fight?” — and leaves it at Owl’s door. No answer lecture; Owl asks one question back. Gulu thinks all afternoon.

adventures.title: One Step on the Bridge
adventures.storyFeeling: New rope bridge sways. Mimi freezes mid-way. Timo on one side, Bobo on other — not pulling. One step, one step, one step.
adventures.synopsis: New rope bridge sways. Mimi freezes mid-way. Timo on one side, Bobo on other — not pulling. One step, one step, one step.

adventures.title: Puddles and Petals
adventures.storyFeeling: Rain ruins Mimi’s picnic sketch plan. She stomps, then watches lotus leaves — wet tops, dry inside. Makes mud art instead.
adventures.synopsis: Rain ruins Mimi’s picnic sketch plan. She stomps, then watches lotus leaves — wet tops, dry inside. Makes mud art instead.

adventures.title: Lunch for Everyone
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu’s lunch crumb trail becomes a feast for ants, bird, and shy mouse. Same food, many hearts — Gulu smiles, not annoyed.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu’s lunch crumb trail becomes a feast for ants, bird, and shy mouse. Same food, many hearts — Gulu smiles, not annoyed.

adventures.title: Timo's Secret Smile
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo helps all week without telling anyone. Owl sees his secret smile at dusk. Timo says, “I feel full inside.”
adventures.synopsis: Timo helps all week without telling anyone. Owl sees his secret smile at dusk. Timo says, “I feel full inside.”

adventures.title: Hello, Wandering Mind
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu tries to listen to Owl; mind jumps to acorns. Owl says, “Hello, mind — come back when you’re ready.” Gulu laughs; focus returns softer.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu tries to listen to Owl; mind jumps to acorns. Owl says, “Hello, mind — come back when you’re ready.” Gulu laughs; focus returns softer.

adventures.title: Too Much Honey
adventures.storyFeeling: Bobo eats, runs, shouts — crash. Owl’s chart: eat, play, rest. Bobo naps without shame; afternoon game is best yet.
adventures.synopsis: Bobo eats, runs, shouts — crash. Owl’s chart: eat, play, rest. Bobo naps without shame; afternoon game is best yet.

adventures.title: Kiki's Flying Thoughts
adventures.storyFeeling: Kiki’s jokes interrupt story hour. Breath count to five; one joke saved for end. Friends clap — timing matters.
adventures.synopsis: Kiki’s jokes interrupt story hour. Breath count to five; one joke saved for end. Friends clap — timing matters.

adventures.title: The Tired Friend
adventures.storyFeeling: Mimi builds stick house; Bobo keeps knocking accidentally. She notices his yawns — builds a nap nook instead.
adventures.synopsis: Mimi builds stick house; Bobo keeps knocking accidentally. She notices his yawns — builds a nap nook instead.

adventures.title: Beads on the String
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu’s necklace breaks; friends find beads in grass, mud, nest. Restrung — same string, scattered pieces made whole.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu’s necklace breaks; friends find beads in grass, mud, nest. Restrung — same string, scattered pieces made whole.

adventures.title: Four Wishes
adventures.storyFeeling: Each friend wants different fair prize. They realize all wishes fit on one bridge walk — together, not competing.
adventures.synopsis: Each friend wants different fair prize. They realize all wishes fit on one bridge walk — together, not competing.

adventures.title: Timo Keeps Asking
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo asks Owl the same gentle question weekly. Answer changes as Timo grows — sincerity matters more than speed.
adventures.synopsis: Timo asks Owl the same gentle question weekly. Answer changes as Timo grows — sincerity matters more than speed.

adventures.title: Firefly Path Home
adventures.storyFeeling: Grove path dark after late story hour. Diya lights a trail; Gulu thinks of Mom’s kitchen lamp — walks brave.
adventures.synopsis: Grove path dark after late story hour. Diya lights a trail; Gulu thinks of Mom’s kitchen lamp — walks brave.

adventures.title: Waiting for Green
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo plants bulb; nothing happens for weeks. Calendar marks; green finally — time was working underground.
adventures.synopsis: Timo plants bulb; nothing happens for weeks. Calendar marks; green finally — time was working underground.

adventures.title: Dusk on the Hill
adventures.storyFeeling: Mimi lost small toy on hill at dusk. Scared but remembers lamp song; finds toy and friend waiting at top.
adventures.synopsis: Mimi lost small toy on hill at dusk. Scared but remembers lamp song; finds toy and friend waiting at top.

adventures.title: Leaf, Flower, Fruit
adventures.storyFeeling: Mimi has nothing fancy for thank-you day — brings one leaf, one flower, one berry. Recipient tears up: “Perfect.”
adventures.synopsis: Mimi has nothing fancy for thank-you day — brings one leaf, one flower, one berry. Recipient tears up: “Perfect.”

adventures.title: Lost and Found
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu wanders off trail; panic. Hears friends calling — not angry, searching. Found in ferns; hug, no scolding.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu wanders off trail; panic. Hears friends calling — not angry, searching. Found in ferns; hug, no scolding.

adventures.title: The Extra Invitation
adventures.storyFeeling: Kiki finds crumpled invite — hedgehog friend never got one. Makes new card with crayon; party grows by one.
adventures.synopsis: Kiki finds crumpled invite — hedgehog friend never got one. Makes new card with crayon; party grows by one.

adventures.title: Best of the Grove Fair
adventures.storyFeeling: Booth celebrates best leaf, best puddle splash, best giggle — every friend wins something real, not ranked.
adventures.synopsis: Booth celebrates best leaf, best puddle splash, best giggle — every friend wins something real, not ranked.

adventures.title: Ant Strong
adventures.storyFeeling: Bobo tries to lift log alone; ants carry crumbs ten times their size beside him. He works with them, not against.
adventures.synopsis: Bobo tries to lift log alone; ants carry crumbs ten times their size beside him. He works with them, not against.

adventures.title: Lamp in the Stack
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo finds glow-worms in book stack — tiny lights in dusty corner. Brings Owl to see; wonder shared quietly.
adventures.synopsis: Timo finds glow-worms in book stack — tiny lights in dusty corner. Brings Owl to see; wonder shared quietly.

adventures.title: River Keeps Going
adventures.storyFeeling: Sit by river; leaves, sticks, fish pass. “Everything goes somewhere,” Kiki says. Friends watch without needing to catch.
adventures.synopsis: Sit by river; leaves, sticks, fish pass. “Everything goes somewhere,” Kiki says. Friends watch without needing to catch.

adventures.title: Sky Bigger Than Fear
adventures.storyFeeling: Night picnic on hill; Mimi afraid of dark until sky opens — stars like spilled sugar. Fear stays small; sky stays big.
adventures.synopsis: Night picnic on hill; Mimi afraid of dark until sky opens — stars like spilled sugar. Fear stays small; sky stays big.

adventures.title: Seasons Wheel
adventures.storyFeeling: Owl’s picture wheel: same tree in rain, sun, snow, bloom. Gulu sees change is normal, not loss only.
adventures.synopsis: Owl’s picture wheel: same tree in rain, sun, snow, bloom. Gulu sees change is normal, not loss only.

adventures.title: Hands on the Bridge
adventures.storyFeeling: After meteor shower watch, friends cold and quiet. Hold hands crossing bridge — big feelings, gentle hearts.
adventures.synopsis: After meteor shower watch, friends cold and quiet. Hold hands crossing bridge — big feelings, gentle hearts.

adventures.title: The Sorry Berry
adventures.storyFeeling: Mimi says mean thing about Bobo’s drawing. Brings sorry berry basket; Bobo forgives, they paint together.
adventures.synopsis: Mimi says mean thing about Bobo’s drawing. Brings sorry berry basket; Bobo forgives, they paint together.

adventures.title: The Bug on the Path
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo angry; almost steps on beetle. Pauses, moves leaf for bug to cross. Anger smaller after.
adventures.synopsis: Timo angry; almost steps on beetle. Pauses, moves leaf for bug to cross. Anger smaller after.

adventures.title: New Bench Friend
adventures.storyFeeling: New otter family on bridge bench. Gulu shy, shares half his sandwich anyway. Otter kid smiles — friendship starts.
adventures.synopsis: New otter family on bridge bench. Gulu shy, shares half his sandwich anyway. Otter kid smiles — friendship starts.

adventures.title: My Plot, My Weeds
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu gets tiny plot — weeds grow fast. Learns to pull gently, water daily. “My mind is like this plot,” Owl whispers once.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu gets tiny plot — weeds grow fast. Learns to pull gently, water daily. “My mind is like this plot,” Owl whispers once.

adventures.title: Quiet After the Boast
adventures.storyFeeling: Bobo brags about jumping highest; falls on tail. Friends don’t tease; Bobo learns proud feeling can be quiet too.
adventures.synopsis: Bobo brags about jumping highest; falls on tail. Friends don’t tease; Bobo learns proud feeling can be quiet too.

adventures.title: Tired Ant, Tired Me
adventures.storyFeeling: Mimi sees ant carrying heavy load — remembers she felt tired yesterday. Brings water drop to anthill path.
adventures.synopsis: Mimi sees ant carrying heavy load — remembers she felt tired yesterday. Brings water drop to anthill path.

adventures.title: Red, Yellow, Blue Day
adventures.storyFeeling: Color festival — Bobo red-rush morning, yellow-buzz noon, blue-calm evening. Same Bobo, different weather.
adventures.synopsis: Color festival — Bobo red-rush morning, yellow-buzz noon, blue-calm evening. Same Bobo, different weather.

adventures.title: Morning Grumble
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu wakes grumpy; everything annoys. Sits under Tree; grumble cloud drifts away by lunch without being forced happy.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu wakes grumpy; everything annoys. Sits under Tree; grumble cloud drifts away by lunch without being forced happy.

adventures.title: Stepping Stone Wobble
adventures.storyFeeling: Stones slippery after rain. Timo wobbles, doesn’t quit — second try across with Mimi cheering softly.
adventures.synopsis: Stones slippery after rain. Timo wobbles, doesn’t quit — second try across with Mimi cheering softly.

adventures.title: Drawing on the Bark
adventures.storyFeeling: Owl sketches tree with roots in clouds on bark — “Some important things hold us from above.” Gulu adds his house in branches.
adventures.synopsis: Owl sketches tree with roots in clouds on bark — “Some important things hold us from above.” Gulu adds his house in branches.

adventures.title: Light Under the Leaves
adventures.storyFeeling: Diya glows under canopy; Gulu sees light filtering through layers — surface fun, deeper glow still there.
adventures.synopsis: Diya glows under canopy; Gulu sees light filtering through layers — surface fun, deeper glow still there.

adventures.title: One Minute Before Fireworks
adventures.storyFeeling: Before noisy finale, Owl rings soft bell — one minute of quiet. Gulu remembers why he loves Grove — not the flash, the friends.
adventures.synopsis: Before noisy finale, Owl rings soft bell — one minute of quiet. Gulu remembers why he loves Grove — not the flash, the friends.

adventures.title: What's in the Toolbox
adventures.storyFeeling: Chest of labeled tools: Truth, Patience, Kind Word, Slow Breath. Friends pick one for the day’s challenge.
adventures.synopsis: Chest of labeled tools: Truth, Patience, Kind Word, Slow Breath. Friends pick one for the day’s challenge.

adventures.title: Three Locked Gates
adventures.storyFeeling: Obstacle course — Angry Gate (shout or breathe), Grabby Gate (take all or share), Show-off Gate ( boast or encourage). Bobo fails, tries again.
adventures.synopsis: Obstacle course — Angry Gate (shout or breathe), Grabby Gate (take all or share), Show-off Gate ( boast or encourage). Bobo fails, tries again.

adventures.title: Walk Away from Gossip
adventures.storyFeeling: Whisper game turns mean about Timo. Mimi walks to Timo’s side publicly — “We’re playing catch instead.”
adventures.synopsis: Whisper game turns mean about Timo. Mimi walks to Timo’s side publicly — “We’re playing catch instead.”

adventures.title: Lunch Line Choices
adventures.storyFeeling: Grove lunch fair — sugary rush vs steady meal. Kiki feels bounce then crash; tries fruit and nuts next day — better game afternoon.
adventures.synopsis: Grove lunch fair — sugary rush vs steady meal. Kiki feels bounce then crash; tries fruit and nuts next day — better game afternoon.

adventures.title: Sharp Tongue, Soft Tongue
adventures.storyFeeling: Mimi’s joke hurts Timo’s feelings. Practices soft truth: “I didn’t mean it; your shell pattern is beautiful.”
adventures.synopsis: Mimi’s joke hurts Timo’s feelings. Practices soft truth: “I didn’t mean it; your shell pattern is beautiful.”

adventures.title: The Anonymous Acorn
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu leaves acorn gift for new family — no name tag. Finds thank-you drawing later; joy without credit.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu leaves acorn gift for new family — no name tag. Finds thank-you drawing later; joy without credit.

adventures.title: Thank You, Tree
adventures.storyFeeling: Owl models short gratitude ritual — “Thank you, page. Thank you, paw. Thank you, friend.” Friends make their own one-line thanks.
adventures.synopsis: Owl models short gratitude ritual — “Thank you, page. Thank you, paw. Thank you, friend.” Friends make their own one-line thanks.

adventures.title: Bitter Medicine Berry
adventures.storyFeeling: Timo must tell friend their tower is unsafe — feels mean, prevents hurt. Friend upset, then grateful.
adventures.synopsis: Timo must tell friend their tower is unsafe — feels mean, prevents hurt. Friend upset, then grateful.

adventures.title: Everyone's Festival Job
adventures.storyFeeling: Year-end festival — each friend finds role: Kiki announces, Mimi decorates, Bobo runs, Timo timing, Gulu welcomes, Owl closes.
adventures.synopsis: Year-end festival — each friend finds role: Kiki announces, Mimi decorates, Bobo runs, Timo timing, Gulu welcomes, Owl closes.

adventures.title: Stop Copying Bobo
adventures.storyFeeling: Gulu always copies Bobo’s stunts. Chooses his own smaller act — seed juggling — crowd loves it because it’s *his*.
adventures.synopsis: Gulu always copies Bobo’s stunts. Chooses his own smaller act — seed juggling — crowd loves it because it’s *his*.

adventures.title: Tree in Full Bloom
adventures.storyFeeling: All six friends + Guru Ma under full Tree — every branch colored, leaves from all 68 adventures referenced visually. Child reader invited to add their leaf. Series closes: “You belong here. Your path is yours.”
adventures.synopsis: All six friends + Guru Ma under full Tree — every branch colored, leaves from all 68 adventures referenced visually. Child reader invited to add their leaf. Series closes: “You belong here. Your path is yours.”
